description: Enterprise. Print-ready PDF logistics report for a Texas site: roads, rail, terminals, ports and airports near it (logistics_screen); ways to bring heavy equipment in, truck direct versus truck-rail-truck with indicative linehaul costs (haul_compare); the heavy-haul truck route from the nearest port or a named origin with posted and low-clearance bridges, low-water crossings and the minor roads on the last miles that may need work (heavy_haul); and crew access: workers within 30/45/60 minutes, lodging, and airline and regional airports with drive times (crew_access). Returns a link that expires in 30 minutes.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

origin.description: nearest_port (default), or a Texas address or town the equipment ships from.

weight_tons.description: Heaviest single load in US tons (gross for the truck route; payload for the cost comparison). Default 120.

name: logistics_report
title: Logistics site report (PDF)
